messages:
Incident Bot: [ALERT] cont-batch p99 latency spike in us-west2 detected. Streaming SLOs breached (p99 > 1s). Auto-pager -> @Priya (oncall). link: https://redwood.ops/alerts/CB-1778004321
Priya (oncall): ack. seeing the alert. picking this up. quick status? any customer 5xxs or just tail latency? :eyes:
Alex M.: I can see p95 ~220ms -> 350ms, p99 jumped to ~1.4s on streaming path for last 6m. Rate steady. No 5xx spike in logs.
Mateo R.: confirmed. metrics dashboard: https://redwood.metrics/d/contbatch/us-west2-streaming. It's correlated with higher mixed-seqlen traffic on pool-3.
Priya (oncall): notable customer impact? Support?
Support Bot: No automated customer outage flags. A handful of realtime customers report UI stalls (non-fatal). One support ticket (#23901) mentions slow responses.
Alex M.: digging into batcher logs now. I see larger-than-expected batches forming for short requests mixed with long ones. Scheduling fairness seems to be letting long sequences block short ones.
Jamie (eng-sre): that matches an earlier regression where we temporarily disabled short-seq prioritization to improve pack utilization. Did we rollback that?
Mateo R.: config for pool-3 shows scheduler_weight_shortseq = 0.1 (reduced). Should be 0.5.
Priya (oncall): can we hotfix to raise short-seq weight and also temporarily cap max_batch_size on streaming? That should reduce tail for short requests.
Alex M.: quick plan: 1) bump scheduler_weight_shortseq to 0.6 2) set max_stream_batch_size=64 -> 32 for pool-3 3) enable preemptive_shortseq=true (if supported) 4) monitor p99.
Priya (oncall): execute step 1 and 2. I'll coordinate rollback if it worsens. Mateo, can you patch configs and roll via runtime config?
Mateo R.: applying config now to pool-3 (us-west2).
Mateo R.: applied:
```
pool: pool-3
scheduler_weight_shortseq: 0.6
max_stream_batch_size: 32
preemptive_shortseq: true
```
Rolling in 30s canary on 3 nodes.
Alex M.: seeing immediate decrease in batch size distribution on the canary nodes. Short requests are getting scheduled earlier.
Priya (oncall): metrics after 90s?
Alex M.: p99 down from 1.4s -> 520ms on canary. p95 back to ~240ms. Not fully healed cluster-wide yet.
Jamie (eng-sre): good. let's widen rollout to remaining nodes with 3 min observation window. Also enable KV prefix caching eviction to free memory for lots of interleaved seqs.
Mateo R.: rolling to rest of pool-3 now. patch id: cfg-1778004321-1.
Priya (oncall): notifying Support for customer messaging. @Support Bot can you create a short internal note to update affected tickets?
Support Bot: Created internal note: "us-west2 cont-batch p99 spike - mitigated by scheduler weight bump. Customers with streaming stalls notified. Ticket group: #23901"
Priya (oncall): paging next oncall for 1-hour handoff: @Kiran. Kiran, handover in 10m unless you want to take now.
Kiran L.: I can take it. thanks team. I'll watch p99 for next hour and be ready to revert if we see regressions. Any config risks?
Alex M.: potential risk: reducing max batch size increases CPU cost. for now the change is conservative (64->32). We'll revert to previous after traffic normalizes.
Mateo R.: also tracked a KV churn rate bump from mixed sequences; enabled selective KV eviction to stabilize memory. Commands run:
```
redwoodctl runtime set pool-3 --set kv.eviction.policy=selective
redwoodctl runtime set pool-3 --set scheduler.shortseq.weight=0.6
```
Outputs looked OK.
Priya (oncall): customer impact assessment: "No customer 500s observed. Several interactive customers experienced increased response latency causing UI stalls. Estimated affected sessions: ~1200 over 10m window. No data loss." We'll prepare a short customer-facing blurb.
Support Bot: Draft message: "We're investigating elevated latency for streaming in us-west2. We've applied mitigations and expect improvement. We'll update in 30 minutes." Approve?
Priya (oncall): approve. Send.
Kiran L.: monitoring dashboards and logs. p99 held ~480-520ms for last 5m cluster-wide. p95 stable. I'll watch for oscillations.
Jamie (eng-sre): postmortem follow-ups: revert the earlier regression that lowered short-seq weight, add a canary test for mixed-seqlen bursts, and tune autoscaling to avoid sustained large batches. I'll file tasks.
Mateo R.: logging note: captured batch composition sample for debugging:
```
[batch_id: b-101]
seq_lens: [12, 1024, 8, 900, 15, 1200]
batch_size: 6
latencies_ms: [40, 1580, 35, 870, 48, 1600]
```
This shows long sequences inflating p99.
Priya (oncall): good capture. Action items: (1) revert shortseq weight regression in mainline (2) add mixed-seqlen unit to loadtests (3) add alert to detect sudden shift in batch composition. Assign owners.
Jamie (eng-sre): I'll own (1) and (3). Mateo will own (2).
Mateo R.: got it.
Kiran L.: taking over live watch. If anything spikes, escalate back to Priya.
Priya (oncall): thanks team. handing off to @Kiran for 1hr. Logging this incident as SEV-2. Will open a postmortem after stabilization. :white_check_mark:
Incident Bot: Incident 1778004321 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Handed to Kiran L.
Kiran L.: acknowledged. I'll post updates if anything changes."
